premises.text: Language barriers create significant challenges in communication.
premises.evidence_span: we had a big problem with language barriers, working, talking day to day, going to the doctor.

premises.text: Crowdsourcing human interpreters can provide real-time translation solutions.
premises.evidence_span: crowdsourcing of human, real-time human interpreters all around the globe.

premises.text: The platform can connect users with interpreters based on specific language needs.
premises.evidence_span: we really want to have that real-time interpreter in your pocket and you connect and you get somebody in your dialect, in your accent, in your language.

premises.text: The service can be used for various contexts, including crisis response.
premises.evidence_span: we created a way for people that really wanted to help the post-tsunami problem that spoke Japanese and English.

premises.text: The platform includes a hybrid model of professional and crowdsourced interpreters.
premises.evidence_span: we have professionals... but at the same time, it's crowdsourced because we really want to target every language in the world.

premises.text: The platform aims to cover nearly all spoken languages globally.
premises.evidence_span: there are nearly 7,000 active spoken languages in the world, and we want to cover every single one of those.

value.text: People can communicate effectively across language barriers.
value.evidence_span: you can travel anywhere in the world and be able to speak with anybody regardless of what language they speak.

notes: No separate premises for interpreter profiles and expertise collection as they support the same premise.
